display_long_description: In this VR simulation, step into the operating room and perform the gold-standard inside-out meniscus repair with lifelike precision! Begin by analysing high-resolution imaging to diagnose a complex tear spanning the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus. With haptic-enabled tools, feel the resistance as you carefully thread sutures from inside the joint to the outside, ensuring strong, stable fixation. Navigate around delicate vascular structures, making strategic incisions while maintaining complete control. Feel the realistic textures and resistance as you navigate the delicate knee anatomy, placing each stitch with expert precision. With immersive 3D visuals and interactive feedback, you’ll gain hands-on experience in perfecting this technique. Step into the virtual operating room and put your surgical skills to the test!
